description: Defines structures, enums, and inline functions for handling HTTP headers in the lsxpack compression library, including header parsing, indexing, and hash management.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_set_idx
methods.description: Initializes an lsxpack_header with a static HPACK index and header value.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_set_qpack_idx
methods.description: Initializes an lsxpack_header with a QPACK index and header value.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_set_offset
methods.description: Sets header offsets based on buffer, name offset, name length, and value length.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_set_offset2
methods.description: Sets header offsets with explicit name and value offsets and lengths.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_prepare_decode
methods.description: Prepares an lsxpack_header for decoding by setting buffer, offset, and length.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_get_name
methods.description: Retrieves the header name from the buffer.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the header value from the buffer.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_get_dec_size
methods.description: Calculates the total size needed for decoding the header.

methods.name: lsxpack_header_mark_val_changed
methods.description: Marks the header's value as changed, updating flags accordingly.
